en: Colorized vintage view of a broad tree-lined promenade with people walking and a street sweeper in the foreground. At the left stands a large statue on a pedestal in front of a mountain backdrop. Decorative street lamps and a fountain or monument appear further down the avenue. The scene is tranquil and framed by tall trees under a partly cloudy sky. The upper left corner bears a printed caption.
